summary: Cypherpunk Technologies Inc. filed an 8-K to report receipt of a Nasdaq compliance letter confirming the company regained the minimum bid price requirement under Listing Rule 5550(a)(2). No transaction, board change, or strategic action is described. The filing is purely a routine regulatory update on continued listing status. There are no deal terms, shareholder meetings, or special-situation catalysts. The matter is closed with no further action required. The registrant is the issuer filing a routine current report.
